ayahOccurrences.text: مُّذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَلَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلًا
ayahOccurrences.highlightedHtml: مُّذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ لَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَلَآ إِلَىٰ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ۚ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَلَن تَجِدَ لَهُۥ سَبِيلًا

lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: accusative masculine plural (form II) passive participle
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: مُّذَبْذَبِينَ is in the derivative form: مُذَبْذَبِينَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ذ/ب/ذ/ب   dh–b–dh–b to make something dangle or move to and fro; to perplex; to harm; to be in a state of commotion. Of this root, only مُذَبْذَبُون mudhabdhabūn occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
مُذَبْذَبِينَ mudhabdhabına [pl. of pass. part. مُذَبْذَبٌ mudhabdhab] ones who are pulled from two opposite directions, who keep swinging from one side to the other, waverers

(4:143) مُذَبْذَبِينَ بَيْنَ ذَلِكَ لاَ إِلَى هَؤُلاَءِ وَلاَ إِلَى هَؤُلاَءِ wavering all the time between [this and] that, [belonging] neither to one side nor the other.
